no visible AI faults — no warped hands/faces/paws, melted objects, or gibberish text/logos in the photos themselves
all overlay words and Shop Now buttons are readable and do not cover the harness, faces or product
persona, season and look fit the creative kit: 34-year-old city dog owner after a pulling walk, early-November autumn leaves, editorial daylight in rust/oat/deep green
avoid list holds: no animals in distress, vets/clinics, in-photo text/logos, second harness/fountain, other brands, or people's faces
